headline: US Manufacturing PMI Surpasses Expectations in Economic Outlook Boost
summary: The US Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index surpassed market expectations, providing a boost to the broader economic outlook.
why: The manufacturing PMI is a key leading economic indicator that helps investors gauge industrial momentum, inflationary pressures, and the overall health of the US economy.

impacts.name: US Manufacturing
impacts.why: A PMI reading above expectations directly points to expanding industrial activity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Exceeding consensus macroeconomic forecasts signals stronger-than-expected industrial demand, lifting sentiment across cyclical equities and growth assets.
